answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 156387 Country: India Title: If Quran falls by mistake by someone then what should he do? Question: If Quran falls by mistake by someone then what should he do? Answer ID: 156387 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 258/196/L=2/1439) There is no particular penalty described by Shariah in case the Holy Quran falls by mistake. However, it is better to do taubah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
